conventions.rig: Mixamo skeleton from Sitting_Talking.fbx (65 bones), skeleton only, 30 fps, frames start at 1
conventions.coordinates: same as the batting clips: x = toward the bowler's end along the pitch, striker's popping crease at 0, other popping crease at 17.68 m; the batter runs in a lane just off the pitch
conventions.bat: right-handers: bat on mixamorig:RightHand (bat_attachment_reference_RIGHT_HANDED.fbx, same socket as the batting clips); left-handers: bat on mixamorig:LeftHand (bat_attachment_reference_LEFT_HANDED.fbx)
conventions.top_hand: comes off the handle while running and pumps freely; both hands are on the bat in the stance
conventions.event_frame: 1-based frame where the bat toe crosses the popping crease (use it for run-out decisions)
conventions.left_handers: lhb_ clips are exact mirrors across the pitch line, so the bowler is in the same place
conventions.chaining: run_loop_with_bat for the middle of a run; run_turn_for_second starts and ends at loop speed; drag/dive start at loop speed

clips.event: bat grounded back behind the non-striker's crease
clips.note: non-striker backing up toward the striker's end is sent back: brakes, turns to the left, sprints back and slides the bat in

clips.event: bat grounded back behind the striker's crease
clips.note: sets off from the stance, brakes hard with the top hand up ('No!'), turns to the left and scrambles back, sliding the bat in

clips.event: bat toe crosses the popping crease
clips.note: sprints in, launches into a full-length dive with the bat stretched out flat along the ground, slides over the line, gets up

clips.event: bat toe crosses the popping crease
clips.note: at full speed, stretches the bat out ahead and drags the toe along the ground over the line, then pulls up
sprinting between the wickets, bat carried in the bottom hand, top hand pumping

clips.event: bat grounded over the far popping crease
clips.note: from the batting stance: pivot, accelerate, sprint, slide the bat over the line at the bowler's end and pull up

clips.event: bat grounded over the line before turning
clips.note: arrives at speed, grounds the bat over the popping crease, plants and turns to the left, sprints back for the next run; start and end match run_loop_with_bat
